summary.resource_boundary: AlphaFold DB excludes viral proteins (query + HCV/HIV/rhinovirus refs all 404) -> full unbiased blind structural screen needs a hand-built viral PDB reference; documented.
summary.sequence_baseline: GENERALIZE1: 0 sequence hits at e<=1e-5 vs a 2145-seq reference that INCLUDED rhinovirus 3C / HCV / HIV -> any structural match here is recovered where sequence gave nothing.
summary.test: GENERALIZE2 confirmatory structural-bridge (Foldseek TM) — CAPABILITY not blind screen
summary.verdict: STRUCTURAL-BRIDGE CONFIRMATORY TEST (PASS). Foldseek TM of the two SARS-CoV-2 drug targets vs a non-coronaviral drugged-enzyme reference + negative controls. Mpro top hit: rhinovirus-3C-protease (class protease, TM 0.43, seq_ident 0.099). RdRp top hit: HCV-NS5B-polymerase (class polymerase, TM 0.473, seq_ident 0.068). BOTH viral drug-target folds are correctly recovered by STRUCTURE (protease->protease-clan, polymerase->polymerase) with meaningful TM despite ~0 sequence homology -> structure bridges exactly the gap sequence could not (GENERALIZE1). CONCLUSION: the viral-generalization failure is a SEQUENCE-TOOL limitation, not fundamental; the structural path is viable and is blocked only by AlphaFold DB's exclusion of viral structures (a fetch/tooling boundary, solvable by a PDB-based reference), NOT by the method. SCOPE: confirmatory capability test on 2 targets w/ chosen controls (NOT a blind discovery ranking); TM on experimental PDB structures; establishes the PRINCIPLE, not a deployed viral pipeline; not wet-lab; n=1 virus.
